mapper.select: INSERT INTO dead_letter (tenant_id, source, message_body, error) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{source}, #{messageBody}, #{error}) RETURNING dead_letter_id
SELECT dead_letter_id, tenant_id, source, message_body, error, status, received_at FROM dead_letter WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY received_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dead_letter SET status = #{status}, settled_at = now(), -- 显式 jdbcType：detail 为 null 时 PostgreSQL 需要知道参数类型，否则报 -- "could not determine data type of parameter $3"（首跑就 500 在这） error = CASE WHEN #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN error ELSE #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR} END WHERE dead_letter_id = #{deadLetterId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'PENDING', max_attempts = attempts + #{extraAttempts}, next_attempt_at = now(), lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = NULL, last_error = #{reason}, updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('DEAD', 'MANUAL_REVIEW')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_intervention (tenant_id, target_type, target_id, action, operator_id, operator_name, reviewer_name, reason, before_state, after_state) VALUES (#{i.tenantId}, #{i.targetType}, #{i.targetId}, #{i.action}, #{i.operatorId}, #{i.operatorName}, #{i.reviewerName}, #{i.reason}, #{i.beforeState}, #{i.afterState})
mapper.select: SELECT intervention_id, tenant_id, target_type, target_id, action, operator_id, operator_name, reviewer_name, reason, before_state, after_state, occurred_at FROM ops_intervention ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
